document.about: FDA Laboratory Information Bulletin 4640 (Adobe Paper Capture). Its validation table's header names each measure over its qualifier, both rows bold and unshaded: `RT (min) | RT %Shift | Regression | SD | LOD | LOQ` over `Drug Name | Ave (n=18) | ΔRTmax/RT | R2, an example | unit of X …`.
